questions.question: Why did a large crowd follow Jesus across the Sea of Galilee?

answers.text: They saw His signs on the sick
He invited them to the mountain

questions.question: When Jesus fed about five thousand people with five barley loaves and two fish, how much did each person get?
When a crowd was about to make Jesus king by force, what did Jesus do?

answers.text: Went off to a mountain by Himself
Sent the crowd away to the villages
Let them take Him to Jerusalem

questions.question: When Jesus walked on the sea toward His terrified disciples in their boat, what did He tell them?

answers.text: Do not be afraid because it is I
Stay quiet and hold on tight
